verdict.rationale: BAMF's evidence describes an informational government website and service tools such as BAMF-NAvI, with no mention of any API, let alone one matching the UI. A public-sector digital service could plausibly expose programmatic access, so the axis applies. With no evidence of an API, the verdict is none rather than na.
